summary: Two people separated from raft at John Martin Reservoir; female rescued by civilian watercraft; Harley Benson (23) of Las Animas drowned, body recovered June 20 after multi-day multi-agency search
responding_agency: Bent County Sheriff's Office; Hasty Fire/Ambulance; Colorado State Parks; U.S. Army Corps of Engineers; Lamar Fire Department; Care Connect; Prowers County Sheriff's Office; Las Animas Fire Department; Pueblo County Sheriff's Office dive team; Colorado Springs Fire Department dive team; El Paso County SARDOC K9
notes: Female rescued uninjured by passing boaters; male victim's body recovered June 20. Prowers Journal recovery report (parent-opened run 632): body recovered ~1 p.m. Monday 2016-06-20 in ~20 ft of water ~0.5 mi south of the railroad trestle, El Paso Fire dive team off a Pueblo West dog-team alert, Prowers County Rural FD assisted; search began Saturday afternoon. Merged 2026-09-15.
